validation.action_hash: SHA-256 over the canonical ordered integer action sequence
validation.record_trace_hash: SHA-256 over ordered record identity, action, authorization, primary execution state, correlation identity, and reconciled receipt state when execution receipts are enabled
validation.config_bound_trace_hash: SHA-256 binding the record trace hash to the run configuration manifest hash when execution receipts are enabled
validation.authorization_execution_invariant: cross-log reconciliation between primary trace and independently emitted downstream execution receipts when enabled
